meta.name: Create real estate listing packages from room photos with Anthropic Claude

name: Create real estate listing packages from room photos with Anthropic Claude

parameters.content:
## Empty-Room to Full-Listing Pipeline

Turn a single empty-room photo into a ready-to-publish real estate listing: an AI-staged render, a comp-based price recommendation, and AI-written listing copy — delivered straight to your inbox.

Built for real estate agents, property managers, and listing platforms who want a listing-ready package minutes after a photo shoot, not days.

### How it works
1. A form captures the empty-room photo plus property basics (address, type, beds, baths, square footage).
2. Two APIs run in parallel: a virtual-staging/3D-rendering API furnishes and styles the room and returns a walkthrough link, while a comps API pulls recent comparable sales near the address.
3. A Code node merges both responses into pricing inputs: average comp price, price-per-sqft, and a suggested price range.
4. Claude writes the listing title, description, key selling points, and a suggested list price.
5. A Code node parses the AI output into structured data (with a rule-based fallback if parsing fails), then assembles the final package.
6. The complete listing is emailed to the agent, ready to publish.

### Setup
1. Import this workflow into n8n.
2. Add your Anthropic Claude credentials to the Anthropic model node.
3. Add your virtual-staging/3D-rendering API credentials to Fetch AI Virtual Staging Render.
4. Add your comps/market-data API credentials to Fetch Comparable Listings & Market Data.
5. Add SMTP credentials to Send Full Listing Package Email and update the from/to addresses.
6. Activate the workflow and open the form URL to submit a room photo.

### Customization
- Add staging style options (Modern, Traditional, Scandinavian) as a form field.
- Log every generated listing to a Google Sheet or CRM.
- Add a second AI pass to generate social captions from the listing copy.
- Push the finished listing directly into your MLS or listing platform instead of email.

## Stage 1: Photo In, Staging & Comps Out

The form captures the room photo and property details. Two APIs run in parallel — AI staging/3D render and comps data. A Code node merges them into pricing inputs (avg price, price/sqft, suggested range).

## Stage 2: AI Copywriting

A short wait respects API rate limits. Claude then turns the staged render, comp pricing, and property details into a listing title, description, selling points, and suggested list price.

## Stage 3: Assemble & Deliver

A Code node parses the AI output (with a rule-based fallback), then another assembles the staged image, 3D link, comp pricing, and copy into one package — emailed to the agent, ready to publish.
